sA.text:
Direction: VM manager first.

The home screen is a live fleet table (status, template, CPU, memory, disk, sessions, ports), not a terminal. Shells are something you launch from a node, not the frame the app lives in.

Look: the codelima.com palette (ink #0c1015, mint #91e6c0) on a strict monospace cell grid: JetBrains Mono 13/20, one cell = 1ch × 20px. Everything draws with text glyphs (block bars, sparklines, panels), so it ports directly to Vaxis.

Status never relies on color alone: every state has its own glyph (● ◐ ◑ ○ ◌ ✕ ⊘).

Vocabulary stays the CLI's: node, environment, and configuration, which the UI labels "template" per this brief. Header tabs and footer key hints are clickable in Play.

sB.text:
Nodes · interactions

• ↑↓ or j/k move · ⏎ opens detail · esc clears the filter, then the marks.
• s starts or stops (the label follows state) · r restarts · x attaches a shell · X opens the shell menu.
• n new · c clone · d delete · l logs · o opens the first forwarded port.
• space marks rows; s / r / d then act on every marked node (one confirm).
• / filters as you type: free text plus status: template: dir: tokens. < > move the sort column, = reverses.
• G toggles grouping by directory: on in the all-nodes view, off in a scoped `codelima .` view.
• Data refreshes every 1s from the daemon. In-flight rows show their current step and never offer a guest shell until ready.
• Width ≥ 140 cols: table + preview. 100–139: no preview. < 100: compact columns (see 80×24).

sC.text:
Node detail · interactions

• ⏎ from Nodes opens Overview; esc returns with the same row selected.
• tab / shift+tab cycle Overview · Metrics · Logs · Spec (+ Shell when the embedded terminal is on). Number keys stay global.
• Every node key works here too: s r x X c d l.
• Overview: ↑↓ in Sessions, ⏎ attaches, t new guest shell, T new host shell, K ends a session. In Ports, o opens, y copies.
• Metrics: + / − change the window 1m · 5m · 15m · 1h; p sorts processes by CPU or memory.
• Logs: [ ] cycle the source (events, bootstrap, lima, serial) · f follow · / search · n/N next/prev match · w wrap.
• Starting: a step tracker replaces Overview until the node is ready; s cancels (stops the VM). Host shells (T) still work.
• Failed: leads with the failing step, command, exit code and a suggested fix; r retries from the failed step.

sD.text:
Forms & confirms · interactions

• tab / shift+tab or ↑↓ move fields · ⏎ or → open a choice list · type to filter it · ctrl+s submits from any field · esc cancels (asks only if edited).
• Validation is live and inline: name unique and slug-safe, directory exists and sits outside CODELIMA_HOME, ports as HOST:GUEST.
• Defaults show as muted placeholders (name from the directory leaf, current directory). Typing replaces them.
• Fit check compares the template with free host capacity: vCPU overcommit warns amber, memory beyond free RAM warns coral. Neither blocks.
• Delete needs the node name typed. Stop asks only when a session is busy. Bulk actions list every target. Clone explains the stop, copy, restart of a running source.

sE.text:
Templates · interactions

• 2 (or a) opens Templates; tab switches Configurations ⇄ Environments (g jumps straight there).
• n new (copies small) · e edit · c clone · d delete (refused while a live node uses it, and says which) · N creates a node from the selected template.
• Edit: ←→ step vCPU, memory, disk through sizes, or type a value · space toggles an environment · shift+↑↓ reorders it · ⏎ in Bootstrap opens a multi-line editor.
• The right column previews the resolved bootstrap order exactly as a new node will freeze it.
• Saving never touches existing nodes; the toast says how many keep their frozen values.
• small is the default: editable, can't be renamed or deleted. Built-ins show “modified” after an edit; R restores one.

sF.text:
Fleet-wide views · interactions

• 3 Ports: every forwarded route across nodes. o opens in the browser, y copies, ⏎ jumps to the node, p pins which node owns bare localhost:PORT when two serve the same port.
• 4 Activity: running operations on top (K cancels where safe), history below. f cycles all / warnings / errors. ⏎ jumps to the node or log. Replaces the m messages view; m still opens it.
• 5 System: doctor checks with R repair, daemon status (u updates in place and keeps sessions), host capacity and settings. ⏎ toggles or edits a setting; changes write settings.yaml.
• Header badges: Activity counts running operations (◐1), System counts open warnings (⚠2).

sG.text:
Shell · the terminal is optional

• x attaches the node's daemon-owned session straight into your terminal. The TUI suspends and the session gets the real terminal (no embedded emulator). Ctrl+] detaches back to where you were, with a status line that the session keeps running. exit ends it.
• X opens the shell menu: attach here, new window (command template), tmux window (when $TMUX is set), host shell, or an existing session.
• Settings › shell.mode sets what x does: attach (default) · window · tmux · embedded.
• embedded keeps today's libghostty tabs inside Node detail as an opt-in. F6 is the only key the TUI takes from the shell there, so Option+←/→ reach it (roadmap #1). Tab keys work while the TUI has focus.
• : opens the command palette anywhere; ? shows the keymap for the current screen.
